correctness.rationale: Under a common Poisson reset clock, the stationary generator closes the first two angular Fourier harmonics and the complex positional first/second moments. Correct subtraction of the squared nonzero mean gives Delta=v^2 r P/positive denominator, with P quartic. The coefficient list has exactly two Descartes sign changes, while P(0)>0, P(d)<0 and P(infinity)>0; hence exactly two distinct simple positive zeros, one on either side of d, and the asserted three regimes. Dimensionless rescalings prove each of four root limits. Isotropic Brownian noise cancels from the traceless moment. The standalone script checks symbolic expansion, all rescaling limits, sign examples, and independently evaluates renewal-age/angular-correlation double integrals with maximum error below 7e-5 in six cases. Finite tests are corroboration, not universal proofs.

Focused mathematical-record queries yielded no same-object equivalent; further publication-priority uncertainty is explicitly retained.

value.rationale: The core natural observable is the stationary centered longitudinal/transverse covariance ordering in the exact active trapped reset model. A two-transition reentrant axis exchange for every k,d>0 is a complete and predictive phase diagram not apparent from a pair of moment formulas. Its independence from propulsion amplitude and isotropic temperature isolates a universal geometry, while singular root scalings explain the free-particle disappearance and strong confinement. This is a motivated classification rather than a numerical slice, parameter renaming or routine small correction; it makes no claim to higher-order isotropy.
